do.name: Aiguille du Midi cable car
do.detail: The world's highest vertical-ascent cable car lifts you to 3,842 m for the Mont Blanc panorama and the glass Step into the Void.

do.name: Montenvers train to the Mer de Glace
do.detail: Red cog railway climbs from town to France's largest glacier, with an ice grotto carved fresh each year.

do.name: Balcony hikes and Lac Blanc
do.detail: Grand Balcon paths traverse the valley wall; from La Flegere a steady climb reaches Lac Blanc and its Mont Blanc mirror.

do.name: Brevent side for the Mont Blanc view
do.detail: Ride Planpraz then the Brevent cable car to 2,525 m on the sunny side of the valley, facing the whole massif.

do.name: Vallee Blanche glacier descent
do.detail: The classic 20 km off-piste glacier run from the Aiguille du Midi; strong skiers go roped up with a guide.

do.name: Ski the Chamonix valley
do.detail: Separate areas from Grands Montets to Balme under one pass; famed steeps make it a freeride pilgrimage.

do.name: Tramway du Mont Blanc
do.detail: France's highest rack railway climbs out of Saint Gervais to the Nid d'Aigle at the foot of the Bionnassay glacier, the old walking start for Mont Blanc.

do.name: UTMB week
do.detail: Late August the valley fills for the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc finals; 10,000 runners and a street-party finish line.
